relations.subject: Richard Gombrich
relations.evidence: The title of this book is a gesture of homage to the late Ven. Dr Walpola Rahula, who taught me much of what I understand of early Buddhism.

relations.subject: Richard Gombrich
relations.evidence: In arriving at my own ideas, I owe enormous intellectual debts, above all to Joanna Jurewicz and to Sue Hamilton.

relations.subject: Noa Gal Ronkin
relations.evidence: I must also make special mention of my comparatively recent students Noa Gal Roilkin and Alexander Wynne. Teachers can have no greater reward than to find their pupils reaching higher by standing on their shoulders.
